goal: Make successful typed screen operations produce deterministic, stack-safe post-operation navigation without inventing missing identity context or changing persistence/product semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep continue-setup replacing all history with PLAN.
Successful editor saves and close/outcome operations leave the editor using back-stack semantics where identity context is not safely available.
Deleting the active batch or recipe returns to its safe primary collection destination and cannot reveal the deleted detail by Back.
Completion handling is conditional on the active screen/operation pair so unrelated commands cannot navigate accidentally.
Tests cover create/update completion, destructive completion, close/observation completion, stack depth, and no-op unknown operations.
No data, Compose UI, platform, build, ledger, or external-service changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
